blocks.text: Ezra 6 contains 22 verses. It opens with: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon. It concludes with: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for Jehovah had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
